note: Closed motion vocabulary from the measured IX3/IX2 interactions (CLONE_SPEC.md 14, CLONE_SPEC-PAGES.md 1.M-8). reducedMotionFallback is required on every PageSpec node and must equal the value here (MOTION_FALLBACK_MISMATCH). Honest gap: the clone itself has no prefers-reduced-motion handling (cloneReducedMotionBehaviour). Timings are CLONE_SPEC values; the original's IX3 timelines were read from its registration payload and spot-sampled, not frame-recorded for the inner pages.

load-intro-home.description: Home load timeline (IX3 wf:load): hero opacity, h1 chars random mask stagger 0.5, heading width 86% -> 100% at 1.25s (0.8s circ.out), hero wrap height 90vh -> auto at 1.27s, nav/info chars at 1.59s, subhead 1.75s, hero cards 1.86-1.89s, button lines 2.22s (1s), contact arrows 2.93s; ends ~3.57s.

evidence.needle: The intro finishes at about t = 3.57s

load-intro-home.cloneReducedMotionBehaviour: unchanged: the clone has no prefers-reduced-motion branch (src/motion/*.js gate only on breakpoints via gsap.matchMedia; at <=767 it renders the static end state). reducedMotionFallback is therefore what a GENERATED page must do, not what the clone does.
